title: Sinch Q3 Product Review
transcript:
Jad Fis: Good morning everyone, let's get started with the Q3 review. Alice, do you want to kick us off with the roadmap update?
Alice Lee: Sure. So we've reprioritised the Meetings integration to Q3 and pushed the billing work to Q4. The main driver is the Transcribe Tonic rollout.
Bob Chen: That makes sense to me. The infrastructure on our end is ready to support it. We finished the capacity review last week.
Jad Fis: Great. Bob, can you confirm the SLA targets are still achievable with the new timeline?
Bob Chen: Yes, we're comfortable with 99.9% uptime on the webhook service. We have failover in place.
Alice Lee: One thing I wanted to flag — we still haven't confirmed the LM Studio model selection for the processing pipeline.
Jad Fis: That's on me. I'll have it confirmed by end of week. Qwen3 27B is the current front-runner.
Bob Chen: Sounds good. I'll schedule a follow-up with DevOps to make sure the GPU allocation is locked in.
Alice Lee: I'll update the roadmap deck and share it before Friday's standup.
